description: This source file defines an abstract class BatchJob implementing the RunnableSchedulerJob interface. It provides a framework for batch processing jobs, including methods for managing tracking tables, processing data in batches, and updating job status. The class is intended to be extended by concrete implementations that specify specific batch processing logic.

classes.name: BatchJob
classes.description: An abstract class that provides the framework for batch processing jobs, including setup, execution, and tracking mechanisms suitable for extending with specific batch logic.

methods.name: setJob
methods.description: Assigns a SchedulersJob instance to the job.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a batch job, managing data processing, tracking, and job status updates.

methods.name: getJobKey
methods.description: Returns a unique string identifier for the job; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: setupTracking
methods.description: Initializes tracking data; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: shouldRun
methods.description: Determines whether the job should run; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Performs initial setup before job execution; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getAllIdsInGroup
methods.description: Retrieves all IDs for a specific group; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: processBatch
methods.description: Processes a batch of data given its type and IDs; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getTrackingTableName
methods.description: Returns the name of the tracking table for a specific type.

methods.name: initTrackingTable
methods.description: Creates and populates a tracking table with IDs to process.

methods.name: updateTrackingTable
methods.description: Updates the tracking table to mark IDs as processed.

methods.name: getIdsBatch
methods.description: Retrieves a batch of IDs pending processing from the tracking table.

methods.name: getGroupBatchInfo
methods.description: Returns batch-related info for a specific group.

methods.name: getBatchSize
methods.description: Returns the batch size considering possible override in data.

methods.name: getNextBatch
methods.description: Determines the next batch to process based on tracking data.

methods.name: getUpdatedCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of items already processed in the current dataset.

methods.name: updateJobStatus
methods.description: Updates the job's data and status to reflect progress.

methods.name: markComplete
methods.description: Marks the job as successfully completed.
